page.content:
The Fédération Internationale de l'Automobile — sport's rule-maker.

How FIA connects

  • Topic: Formula 1 — The FIA governs Formula 1 and awards its world championships.
  • Item: World Drivers' Championship — The FIA awards the World Drivers' Championship.
  • Item: World Constructors' Championship — The FIA awards the World Constructors' Championship.

What is FIA?

The FIA governs Formula 1: the technical regulations, the stewards, and the World Championships it awards to drivers and constructors.

Key threads lead to Formula 1, World Drivers' Championship and World Constructors' Championship.
